questions.question: List out the types of RTD beverages?
questions.solution_html:
• RTD Tea & Coffee, Dairy-Based RTD Drinks, Fruit & Vegetable Juices, Functional RTD
  • Drinks, Meal Replacement Drinks, Alcoholic RTD Drinks
  • Selection of raw materials – high-quality fruits, milk, or vegetables.
  • Shelf-stable – Many RTD drinks can be stored at room temperature due to aseptic or
  • UHT (Ultra-High Temperature) processing.
  • Convenient and time-saving
  • May contain added sugar or preservatives
questions.final_answer: May contain added sugar or preservatives
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Which are the pre-processing steps for raw materials?
questions.solution_html:
• • Sorting and grading: To ensure uniformity.
  • • Washing and sanitizing: To remove dirt and microorganisms.
  • • Peeling, cutting, and trimming: For processing convenience.
  • • Blanching or pre-cooking: To inactivate enzymes and reduce microbial load.
  • • Weighing and mixing: To maintain formulation consistency.
  • Extraction or preparation – juice extraction, blending, or homogenization.
  • Portable – Available in easy-to-carry containers such as bottles, cans, or tetra packs.
  • Portable and hygienic packaging
  • Some may lose nutritional value during processing
questions.final_answer: Some may lose nutritional value during processing
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: What is the purpose of allergen management in food safety?
questions.solution_html:
• Allergen Management is a critical component of food safety systems such as HACCP
  • ISO 22000, FSSAI, and FDA FSMA. It ensures that foods are safe for consumers
  • with food allergies and helps prevent allergic reactions caused by unintended allergen
  • presence.
  • Formulation – adjusting sugar, acidity (using citric acid), and flavoring.
  • Ready for immediate consumption – No need for mixing, brewing, or refrigeration
  • before drinking.
  • Long shelf life
  • Costlier than preparing homemade beverages
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: What leads to the evolution of packaged foods in 20th century?
questions.solution_html:
• • Refrigeration and pasteurization allowed perishable foods to last longer.
  • • The rise of food brands introduced standardized, packaged products.
  • • World Wars I & II (1914–1945) demanded compact, durable, nutritious foods
  • for soldiers. After the wars, these military technologies were adapted for
  • civilian markets, giving rise to the instant food industry.
  • Filtration and pasteurization – to remove impurities and destroy microbes.
  • Wide variety – Includes both health-based and indulgent options.
  • Consistent taste and quality
  • Environmental concerns related to single-use packaging
questions.final_answer: Environmental concerns related to single-use packaging
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: List out the functions of FSSAI?
questions.solution_html:
• • Lays down science-based food standards.
  • • Regulates the manufacture, storage, distribution, sale, and import of food.
  • • Ensures availability of safe and wholesome food to consumers.
  • • Acts as a single reference point for all food-related laws in India.
  • Filling and packaging – usually in glass bottles, Tetra Pak cartons, PET bottles, or
  • cans.
  • Preserved flavor and nutrition – Processing methods are chosen to maintain taste and
  • nutrients for a longer shelf life.
  • Advantages of RTD Beverages
  • Suitable for all age groups and occasions
  • Limitations / Concerns
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: List out some packaging materials used in RTE?
questions.solution_html:
• Plastics (Flexible and Rigid), Glass containers, Metal cans (Tin / Aluminium), Paper
  • and paperboard, Laminates and composites
  • Cooling and storage – stored under ambient or refrigerated conditions.
questions.final_answer: Cooling and storage – stored under ambient or refrigerated conditions

  • Flavouring agents- natural and artificial
  • Colouring agents- caramel, sunset yellow

questions.question: What are the mandatory information to be given on a food label?
questions.solution_html:
• • Name of the food
  • • List of ingredients
  • • Nutritional information
  • • Net quantity (weight/volume)
  • • Manufacturer/packer details
  • • Batch/Lot number
  • • Date of manufacture & expiry / best-before
  • • Veg/Non-veg symbol
  • • MRP (Maximum Retail Price)
  • • Instructions for use/storage
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Write about non-thermal processing and its objectives?
questions.solution_html:
• Non-thermal processing involves methods that preserve food without the use of high
  • heat, thus retaining nutritional, sensory, and functional qualities while still ensuring
  • microbial safety.
  • Objectives
  • • To inactivate microorganisms without significant heating.
  • • To retain natural taste, colour, and nutrients.
  • • To reduce energy consumption compared to thermal methods.
questions.final_answer: • To reduce energy consumption compared to thermal methods
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Write a note on the characteristics and processing of RTS?
questions.solution_html:
• Characteristics
  • • Require no further processing — consumed directly from the pack.
  • • Have stable flavor, color, and texture during storage.
  • • Are nutritionally balanced, often enriched with vitamins or minerals.
  • • Have extended shelf life due to thermal or non-thermal processing (like
  • pasteurization, UHT, or aseptic packaging).
  • Processing Steps
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Write a note on the classification of RTE foods?
questions.solution_html:
• • Based on degree of preparation- RTE, RTC
  • • Based on the method of processing- canned, frozen, dried, retort-packed
  • vaccum packed
  • • Based on storage requirements- shelf-stable, chilled, frozen
  • • Based on type of food product- cereal based, meat and fish, fruits and veg
  • traditional
  • • Based on packaging type- canned, vaccum, retort pouch, MAP, frozen pack
  • • Based on consumer use- single-meal packs, family packs, instant
questions.final_answer: • Based on consumer use- single-meal packs, family packs, instant
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Write a note on freeze drying and dehydration?
questions.solution_html:
• Dehydration is the process of removing moisture from food by applying heat, usually
  • by evaporation of water.
  • Freeze drying is a low-temperature dehydration process in which frozen food is dried
  • under vacuum, causing ice to sublimate
  • without melting.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Write about the methods of shelf-life assessment?
questions.solution_html:
• Real-Time Testing, Accelerated Shelf-Life Testing (ASLT), Microbial Challenge
  • Studies
questions.final_answer: Real-Time Testing, Accelerated Shelf-Life Testing (ASLT), Microbial Challenge

questions.question: Write a note on value addition and fortification of RTE foods?
questions.solution_html:
• Value addition means improving a food’s appeal, nutrition, or convenience.
  • Fortification involves enriching foods with essential nutrients to enhance their health
  • benefits.

questions.question: Write an essay on FDA and ISO?
questions.solution_html:
• The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) is a regulatory agency of the United States
  • federal government responsible for safeguarding public health.
  • It oversees the safety, quality, and effectiveness of
  • • Foods
  • • Drugs (human & veterinary)
  • • Cosmetics
  • • Medical devices
  • • Biological products
  • • Tobacco products
  • • ISO (International Organization for Standardization) is an independent, non
  • governmental international body that develops and publishes voluntary global
  • standards to ensure quality, safety, efficiency, and consistency in products, services
  • and systems.

questions.question: Write an essay on RTD foods?
questions.solution_html:
• RTD (Ready-to-Drink) beverages are pre-formulated, processed, and packaged
  • drinks that are ready for direct consumption without any additional preparation like
  • dilution, brewing, or mixing.
  • Purpose
  • The main goal of RTD products is convenience.
  • They are designed for consumers who have busy lifestyles and want quick
  • nutritious, and safe beverage options on the go.
  • Characteristics
